[ASSISTANT_SAID] Start by teaching basic commands such as sit, stay, come, and heel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular training sessions are necessary to ensure your dog remembers the commands you are teaching them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Eliminate distractions when training your dog. A calm and quiet environment will help your dog focus on your commands.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If you are struggling to train your dog, seek the help of a professional trainer who can assess your dog's needs and train them accordingly.
